upgrades.title: A clearer home screen
upgrades.summary: See attendance, tomorrow's class, alerts, progress, and today's activity at a glance.

upgrades.title: Smoother pop-ups and scrolling
upgrades.summary: Screens open, close, and scroll more consistently, with easier dismiss gestures and clearer actions.

upgrades.title: Simpler holidays and curricula
upgrades.summary: Vacation periods replace holiday placeholders, while curriculum changes are carried over more safely.

upgrades.title: More dependable reminders
upgrades.summary: Notifications are filtered more carefully and updates are handled more safely.

upgrades.title: A clearer activity history
upgrades.summary: Attendance changes and subject edits now appear in an easier-to-follow activity timeline.

fixes.title: Section labels stay in place
fixes.summary: Section labels now pin neatly below the app bar while you scroll through Settings, Subjects, and Timetable.

fixes.title: A more reliable Manage tab
fixes.summary: Manage windows scroll correctly, borders stay complete, Add Slot is easier to find, and Edit Slot is clearer.

fixes.title: A tidier attendance dashboard
fixes.summary: Home scrolling, Detox Day, Overall Attendance, and the Max Percentage chart now fit together more cleanly.

fixes.title: More accurate activity entries
fixes.summary: Attendance actions no longer create duplicates, stay in order, and keep undo and redo behavior intact.

fixes.title: Safer data and reminders
fixes.summary: Delete and restore actions are safer, failures are easier to notice, and finished SGT subjects no longer send reminders.
